note: Draft scene bank. Options turn public-domain IPIP behaviours (Goldberg) into choices; situations span the Situational Eight DIAMONDS (Rauthmann et al. 2014). Effect values are first guesses on the 1-7 scale, to be calibrated against TIPI results. v2: restaurant option 4 now measures spending on experience; two twin scenes (twin_of) re-measure Extraversion and Openness in a new situation, for the sincerity check. v3: restaurant gets a 5th option, the restaurant's special (trusted novelty). v4: 'ask the waiter' and 'look it up first' are careful, not open (Openness 0); new duty scene for the dependable side of Conscientiousness (Lokesh test, 26 Oct). v5: life-stage wording (variants). A variant changes only the words; target, options order and effects stay the same, so results stay comparable. Life stage is never used to predict personality. v6: life stage 'home and family' (people caring for home and family) with its own wording; options and effects unchanged.

scenes.text: A new restaurant. The menu has a dish you have never heard of.

options.text: Order many dishes for the table
